headline: Argentina Enters Technical Recession After Two Consecutive Quarters of Economic Contraction
summary: Argentina's economy entered a technical recession after recording two consecutive quarters of contraction, with GDP falling 0.6% in the second quarter and monthly indicators pointing to further drops.
why: Economic recessions in emerging market economies impact sovereign debt valuations, local currency stability, and corporate earnings for domestic operators.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: The national economy entered a recession.
